data.name: Kris
data.gender_notes: Kris is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Kristos,' meaning 'anointed,' which refers to Jesus Christ in Christian theology. The name Kris is a symbolic reminder of bearing and spreading the teachings of Christ. The name Kris carries the meaning “Christ-bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Kris usually hope their child will grow to embody christ-bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes carrying the teachings of Christ.
data.etymology: Kris belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Christ-bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kris total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kris, which is derived from the Greek origin, has been adopted in several cultures as a Christian name. Throughout history, it has featured prominently in European and American traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual meaning of Kris is deeply rooted in Christianity. The name is a reminder of the sacrament of Anointing of the Sick, which represents the spiritual strengthening and healing given by God through the Church. Christ himself was anointed by God with the Holy Spirit and Kris is a constant reminder to live a life that is anointed with His love, grace, and power.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Kris derives from the Greek word "Krissos," meaning golden-haired or golden-horned, representing the divine light and power bestowed upon those who follow Christ. It also symbolizes strength and courage, as the ancient Greek god of the same name was a symbol of these virtues. In Christianity, Kris symbolizes the golden light of Christ's love and the strength to overcome challenges with faith.
